objective: Mean per-rater natural-log loss over eligible phone-position rating distributions
selection: Within each encoder/head/seed/outer-fold combination select learning rate and epoch by inner-speaker macro-target log loss only; exact ties prefer lower learning rate then earlier epoch
outerRefit: Refit selected configuration on outer-fit speakers for the selected fixed epoch count; evaluate outer holdout once afterward
reporting: Retain every trial, failure, selected setting and seed; macro/micro proper scores, per-target and age slices; no winner from historical test metrics
adaptationStage: Separate recipe after memory/gradient and inner-learning evidence; do not use outer labels for architecture or adaptation choices
